review.note: Reviewed fresh public PyPI/npm candidates for every direct build, runtime, development and Node dependency, including versions beyond current upper bounds. All third-party candidate versions are unchanged from the committed Ingest 0.26.0 audit, so their identical-version upstream reviews carry forward; the independent worktree venv contains the current latest direct third-party candidates. Public h2hdb advanced from 0.39.11 to 0.40.0, which remains below the intentionally coordinated h2hdb>=0.41.0,<0.42.0 requirement: schema-7 Core cannot supply the schema-8 initial-scan checkpoint contract. Ingest 0.27.0 permits unknown inventory counts while resuming sealed work, then performs a fresh inventory turn before declaring source catch-up; initial observation checkpoints reuse sealed galleries across process restart. External CBZ byte formats are unchanged. The clean-checkout rebuild must use an explicitly supplied matching Core 0.41.0 wheel until that version is published; no sibling discovery is required. Manual real-process/CBZ/MariaDB evidence and the exact-tree gate are separate. Built candidate wheels h2hdb-0.41.0 and h2hdb_ingest-0.27.0 were explicitly installed together, offline from the existing registry cache, into a newly created independent CPython 3.14.1 virtual environment; uv pip check passed for all 14 runtime packages. Isolated-mode imports resolved only to that environment, direct_url metadata records local wheel files without editable flags, and every installed package file was byte-compared with its wheel (95 Core files and 47 Ingest files). Pillow 12.3.0 and libvips 8.18.6 loaded successfully. This verifies frozen dependency and wheel metadata; implementation work continued after candidate wheel creation, so these candidate hashes do not attest the final runtime tree. The exact-tree gate and final distribution build separately validate the released implementation.
